text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognising images, or making decisions. Machine learning is a part of AI where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large artificial neural networks. Today, AI is used in many parts of daily life. For example, it helps recommend films on streaming services, powers voice assistants on smartphones, and improves navigation apps. Banks also use it to detect fraud. AI is developing quickly and is likely to affect many more areas of our lives in the future.
